caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a green glass vase with a hexagonal base. The vase is shown upright and centered against a plain beige background, enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The body of the vase is tall and vertically elongated, with embossed, rounded rectangular panels arranged symmetrically around it. The rim of the vase is wide and flares outward with wavy, undulating edges. The color of the vase is a rich, translucent green, and the shading is used to show reflections and contours, emphasizing the glassy texture. The stem of the vase is faceted and connects the wide bowl to the equally faceted base, which is hexagonal in shape. No other objects or decoration appear in the image.
title: Vase
